title: Accept Custom Delivery Inputs Through the Shot Pattern GUI Subprocess
body:
## Problem

Editing preset fields relabels the GUI selection custom, but its CLI subprocess rejected --club-preset custom.

## Acceptance Criteria

Accept custom mode without preset replacement; preserve entered delivery values. Verify parser resolution and a headless GUI custom shaft-rotation run.

## Validation

tests/tools/shot_pattern_analysis/test_presets.py, test_entrypoint.py, and tests/ui/tools/shot_pattern_analysis/test_embed_adapter.py; custom and modified club inputs preserve delivery and scoring context.

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
